text:
adele: Heads up — need a compact seat-map diagram + three benchmark slide variants + social tile set for the webinar deck. Deadline Thurs EOD for design handoff to growth. Figma link below. Need brand-compliant color palette and dark-mode variants. Also want an A/B-ready headline set.

sam: On it — can you confirm target sizes and locales? also any new photography?

adele: Sizes: hero for deck 16:9 1920x1080, hero ad 1200x628; social tiles 1:1 1200x1200; thumbnails 600x400. Locales: en, fr, de. No new photos — use existing hero in Figma (page 'Launch shots'). Tone: simple charts (latency vs cost) and a simplified seat map showing routing tiers and fallbacks.

sam: cool. I'll mock 3 variants: Econ-first (cost curve focus), Latency-first, Hybrid-balance. I'll post frames in Figma by tomorrow. Any copy for the tiles?

liam: For tiles: short headline + subhead + CTA. Headlines ideas: 'Serve smarter, ship faster' (A), 'Latency you can bank on' (B), 'Reduce inference costs' (C). CTA: 'Register' or 'Try the benchmark' (we'll A/B). Keep subheads concise (6–10 words).

adele: Agree. For the 'Reduce inference costs' variant we need a vetted number before using % claims — ops to confirm baseline. @jenna legal to scan any claims — if not approved, use 'Reduce inference costs' without %s.

jenna: :wave: I'll check claims — send the quant methodology. For now avoid absolute percentages in hero tiles until signoff. We can approve 'Reduce inference costs' copy and a micro 'See methodology' link.

sam: Noted. I'll keep placeholder 'Reduce inference costs' and add a small 'see methodology' microcopy. Figma frames: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd/launch-assets?node-id=0%3A1 (will post nodes). Quick export spec and naming (also in Figma file):

```
Export sizes/specs:
- deck hero: 1920x1080 PNG @1
- hero ads: 1200x628 JPG @1
- social tile: 1200x1200 SVG + PNG 1200x1200 @1
- thumbnail: 600x400 JPG @1
- dark-mode: same dims, separate export page

Naming convention:
redwood_launch_<assetType>_<locale>_<variant>.png
examples: redwood_launch_hero_en_econ.png, redwood_launch_tile_fr_latency.png

Delivery folder:
gs://redwood-marketing/launch-assets/3618001234/
```

design-ci: Reminder: please upload finalized exports to the delivery folder above. Also include a 72dpi web-optimized jpg for email headers.

adele: Schedule: design review Thurs 10:00 AM PT; dev QA for landing and webinar pages Fri. Sam — can you confirm frames posted by Weds EOD? :pray:

sam: Yep Weds EOD. Will include light/dark export and localized variants in separate pages, and add a short annotation for microcopy and legal notes.

liam: I'll prep email headers, social copy, and registration page copy after review. Need social copy drafts by Thurs noon to sync with paid channels.

adele: Perfect. Thanks team :rocket:
